title: The Signal That Could Have Been a World
title_ja: 一つの世界かもしれない信号
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度・観測は架空の思考実験。実在の調査・統計・実証結果・医療基準・天体発見ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Imagine a team of astronomers working with a hypothetical observatory designed to examine distant planetary systems for signals that might reveal something about conditions on worlds beyond Earth.
sentences.ja: 地球外の世界の条件について何かを明らかにし得る信号を探る仮想観測所で働く天文学者チームを想像しよう。

sentences.en: During a routine analysis, the researchers identify an unusual pattern in a series of recorded measurements, and one member suggests that it might be associated with a phenomenon that their project was originally intended to investigate.
sentences.ja: 通常の分析で記録された測定値の一連に異常なパターンを見つけ、一人は当初調査を意図した現象に関連するかもしれないと提案する。

sentences.en: Other members of the team are excited by this interpretation, particularly because the project has required several years of preparation without producing a result that has attracted much public attention.
sentences.ja: 長年準備しても世間の注目を集める結果が出ていなかったため、他の研究者はこの解釈に特に興奮する。

sentences.en: However, the observation itself does not specify which process produced the pattern, and the researchers must distinguish a scientifically interesting possibility from a conclusion that the available evidence actually supports.
sentences.ja: しかし観察自体はどの過程がパターンを生んだか示さず、科学的に興味深い可能性と根拠が実際に支える結論を区別しなければならない。

sentences.en: The team therefore begins its discussion by listing alternative explanations instead of treating the most exciting interpretation as the one that should receive the greatest confidence.
sentences.ja: そこで最も興奮を誘う解釈を最も確信すべきものと扱わず別の説明を列挙することから議論を始める。

sentences.en: The researchers examine whether the apparent signal could have originated from the equipment itself or from a feature of the method used to process the original measurements.
sentences.ja: 見かけの信号が装置自体や元の測定値の処理方法の特徴に由来し得るか調べる。

sentences.en: A technical specialist identifies a setting that might influence the appearance of certain patterns, although the team does not yet know whether that setting is responsible for the particular observation under discussion.
sentences.ja: 専門家は特定パターンの外観に影響し得る設定を特定するが、それが議論中の観測の原因かはまだ分からない。

sentences.en: The researchers also consider whether an ordinary physical process, different from the phenomenon they hope to investigate, could produce observations resembling those already recorded in the hypothetical dataset.
sentences.ja: 希望する現象とは別の通常の物理過程でも仮想データに記録されたものに似た観測結果を生むか検討する。

sentences.en: These possibilities do not establish that the initial interpretation is incorrect, but they demonstrate why the existence of a pattern alone is insufficient to determine which explanation should be accepted.
sentences.ja: これらの可能性は最初の解釈が誤りだと確定しないが、パターンの存在だけではどの説明を採用すべきか決められない理由を示す。

sentences.en: In order to distinguish among competing explanations, the team identifies observations that would be expected under one interpretation but would be less consistent with another.
sentences.ja: 競合する説明を区別するため、一方の解釈では予想されるが他方には合いにくい観測を特定する。

sentences.en: A second difficulty arises when the researchers attempt to determine how much confidence should be attached to a result selected from a large collection of observations after the entire collection has already been examined.
sentences.ja: 次の難しさは全観測を調べた後で大量の観測の中から選んだ結果にどの程度の確信を付与するべきか決めるときに生じる。

sentences.en: If an unusual pattern is noticed only after many possible combinations have been considered, the fact that it looks impressive may not have the same significance as a pattern that was specifically predicted beforehand.
sentences.ja: 多くの組み合わせを検討した後にだけ異常パターンが見つかったなら、印象的に見えることは事前に具体的に予測したパターンと同じ重要性を持たないかもしれない。

sentences.en: The team recognizes that exploratory analysis can be extremely valuable for generating hypotheses, provided that the resulting hypotheses are not presented as though they had already survived independent attempts to test them.
sentences.ja: 探索的分析は仮説を生むため非常に価値があるが、得られた仮説を独立した検証を既に生き延びたかのように示さないことが条件だと認識する。

sentences.en: The researchers document the procedure through which the pattern was identified and specify in advance what additional observations would strengthen or weaken their proposed explanation.
sentences.ja: 特定手順を記録し、どんな追加観測が提案した説明を強めたり弱めたりするか事前に明示する。

sentences.en: They also consider the practical difficulty of arranging a new observation because the necessary equipment is shared among several projects with their own scientific objectives and scheduling constraints.
sentences.ja: 必要な装置が独自の目的と日程制約を持つ複数の計画で共有されるため、新しい観測を調整する実際的難しさも考慮する。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a fictional public information office asks the team to prepare a short announcement describing the discovery in language that people without specialist training can understand.
sentences.ja: 一方架空の広報室が専門訓練のない人にも分かる言葉で発見を述べる短い発表を作るよう求める。

sentences.en: Some researchers worry that explaining several unresolved alternatives will make the announcement less memorable, especially when audiences are accustomed to headlines presenting scientific advances as definite answers to familiar questions.
sentences.ja: 未解決の別案を説明すると発表が印象に残りにくくなると心配する研究者もいる。特に読者は科学の進歩を既知の問いへの明確な答えとして示す見出しに慣れているからだ。

sentences.en: Others argue that emphasizing the most dramatic possibility without explaining its uncertain status could create expectations that subsequent research might fail to satisfy, even if the project continues to produce useful scientific information.
sentences.ja: 劇的な可能性の不確実な位置づけを説明せず強調すると、その後の研究が有益な科学情報を生み続けても満たせない期待を作るかもしれないと主張する者もいる。

sentences.en: The team decides to describe the recorded pattern, explain why it is worth investigating, and distinguish the proposed explanation from the further evidence needed to evaluate it.
sentences.ja: 記録したパターンと調査に値する理由を説明し、提案された説明と評価に必要な追加根拠を区別することにする。

sentences.en: The announcement makes no claim about the actual discovery of a planet or any extraterrestrial phenomenon, since the entire case is an imagined exercise about reasoning under uncertainty.
sentences.ja: 全体が不確実性下の推論についての仮想練習なので、発表は実際の惑星や地球外現象の発見を主張しない。

sentences.en: This thought experiment illustrates why a surprising observation can represent the beginning of a scientifically productive investigation rather than its conclusion.
sentences.ja: この思考実験は驚くべき観察が科学的に生産的な調査の結論ではなく始まりになり得ることを示す。

sentences.en: An explanation becomes more convincing when it accounts for the available evidence and continues to perform well when compared with other plausible explanations under appropriately designed tests.
sentences.ja: 説明は根拠を説明し適切に設計された試験で他の妥当な説明と比較しても有効であり続けるとより説得的になる。

sentences.en: The willingness to investigate alternative possibilities does not necessarily indicate a lack of enthusiasm for a promising idea; it can instead demonstrate a commitment to discovering whether that idea deserves the confidence initially placed in it.
sentences.ja: 別の可能性を調べる意欲は有望な考えへの情熱不足を必ずしも示さず、むしろ当初置かれた確信に値するかを発見する献身を示し得る。

sentences.en: Public communication of uncertain findings faces a related challenge, since a simplified statement should make a complex investigation understandable without converting a provisional interpretation into an established fact.
sentences.ja: 不確実な成果の広報も簡潔な表現で複雑な調査を理解可能にしつつ暫定的解釈を確立した事実に変えないという関連課題に直面する。

sentences.en: The value of an unexpected signal consequently depends not only on what it might eventually reveal about a distant world, but also on the quality of the questions that it enables researchers to ask next.
sentences.ja: したがって予想外の信号の価値は最終的に遠い世界について明らかにするかもしれないことだけでなく、研究者が次に立てられる問いの質にも依存する。

An unusual pattern in recorded measurements.
questions.explanation_ja: 通常分析で見つけたパターン。

options: Excitement does not establish evidential strength.
The team wishes to avoid further work.
questions.explanation_ja: 興奮と根拠の強さは別。

questions.prompt: What possible source apart from the target phenomenon is considered?
What observations could help distinguish explanations?
options: Those equally compatible with every account.
Those predicted differently by competing accounts.
Those selected only for dramatic appearance.
questions.explanation_ja: 解釈ごとに予想が異なる観測。

questions.prompt: Why does a retrospectively selected pattern need care?
options: Many examined possibilities can make an impressive pattern less evidentially decisive.
A later finding must always be false.
questions.explanation_ja: 多数探索後のパターンの意味。

questions.prompt: What does the team specify in advance?
options: The exact outcome of future measurements.
The final conclusion regardless of evidence.
Observations that could strengthen or weaken the explanation.

questions.prompt: What is the risk of stressing a dramatic possibility?
options: Public expectations may exceed the evidence.
The announcement becomes impossible to understand.
questions.explanation_ja: 根拠以上の期待が生まれる。

options: One verified planet and another verified planet.
Actual alien life and a confirmed signal.
The possible explanation and evidence still needed.
A final discovery and a rejection of further research.
questions.explanation_ja: 仮説と必要な追加根拠。

options: An exciting interpretation is usually the correct one.
Unexpected observations are opportunities for careful hypothesis testing and responsible communication.
Uncertain research should never be communicated.
questions.explanation_ja: 予想外の発見を仮説検証と適切な伝達につなげる。

paraphrases.source: However, the observation itself does not specify which process produced the pattern, and the researchers must distinguish a scientifically interesting possibility from a conclusion that the available evidence actually supports.
paraphrases.rewrite: The pattern itself does not reveal its cause, so a possibility must be distinguished from a supported conclusion.

paraphrases.source: These possibilities do not establish that the initial interpretation is incorrect, but they demonstrate why the existence of a pattern alone is insufficient to determine which explanation should be accepted.
paraphrases.rewrite: Alternative possibilities do not disprove the first interpretation, but show why a pattern cannot by itself settle the explanation.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 別案の存在は反証そのものではない。

paraphrases.source: If an unusual pattern is noticed only after many possible combinations have been considered, the fact that it looks impressive may not have the same significance as a pattern that was specifically predicted beforehand.
paraphrases.rewrite: A pattern discovered after examining many combinations may have less evidential weight than one predicted in advance.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 事前予測と探索後の差。

paraphrases.source: The willingness to investigate alternative possibilities does not necessarily indicate a lack of enthusiasm for a promising idea; it can instead demonstrate a commitment to discovering whether that idea deserves the confidence initially placed in it.
paraphrases.rewrite: Testing alternatives can express commitment to learning whether a promising explanation merits its initial confidence.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 情熱不足でなく検証への献身。
